_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Batch S4 (Joolz/M&P/Mima). Sourced 2026-07-05. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Mima Xari (current: Xari Max / Xari 4G)

clekListed.clekRow: Mima Xari — Xari car seat adapter (G4104)

specs._weightNote: 13.3 kg / 29.3 lb (Xari Max; classic Xari 4G ~29.5 lb).
specs._dimsNote: Folds as two pieces (chassis + seat/carrycot detach). Classic Xari fold 42 x 66 x 89 cm (Strollberry); Xari Max chassis-with-wheels folds ~27.2 x 16.1 x 25.6 in.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: from birth (2-in-1 convertible carrycot/seat; carrycot to ~19.8 lb) to 17 kg (37.5 lb) seat; Xari Max rated to 22 kg / 48.5 lb

safety.standards: EN 1888 (Mima). Clek's official list attests the model was tested to the applicable ASTM stroller/car-seat standard for Liing use.
safety.notes: 5-point harness; reversible seat; full lie-flat recline; signature leatherette/pod seat converts to carrycot. Underseat storage is minimal; basket capacity not published (null).

specs.foldType: two-piece fold (chassis + seat detach); not a one-piece compact fold
specs.tires: 8.7 in front / 11.8 in rear (22 cm / 30 cm) EVA foam-coated wheels

notes: Luxury modular pram (~29.3 lb) — statement design, not the ultralight/compact city goal, and the priciest item in this batch (~$1,500 for the current Xari Max). Clek lists 'Mima Xari' with the Xari car seat adapter G4104; the current Mima Xari Max/4G adapter explicitly lists Clek Liing (mimakidsusa). Seat weight rating varies by generation (classic Xari 17 kg / 37.5 lb; Xari Max 22 kg / 48.5 lb) — recorded 37.5 with note.
